description: Header file defining interfaces for PowerManager implementation and API, including abstract class PowerManagerImpl with virtual methods for power management functionalities and a concrete class PowerManagerAPI with static methods delegating to an implementation instance.

classes.name: PowerManagerImpl
classes.description: Abstract class with virtual methods for power management operations, to be implemented by specific hardware or platform-specific classes.

classes.name: PowerManagerAPI
classes.description: Class providing static methods to interact with PowerManager implementation, acting as an interface layer.

methods.name: PLAT_API_SetPowerState
methods.description: Sets the power state of the device.

methods.name: PLAT_API_SetWakeupSrc
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific wakeup source.

methods.name: PLAT_API_GetWakeupSrc
methods.description: Checks if a wakeup source is enabled.

methods.name: PLAT_TERM
methods.description: Terminates or cleans up power management.

methods.name: PLAT_DS_SetDeepSleep
methods.description: Configures deep sleep mode with timeout and wakeup settings.

methods.name: PLAT_DS_GetLastWakeupReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason for the last wakeup.

methods.name: PLAT_DS_GetLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Retrieves the key code associated with the wakeup event.
